items.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Western swing which is a music originated by Bob Wills... I was in a really fun big band that emulated that Bob Wills style.

ctx.x: But your musical tastes have not been confined to just, say, the jazz world either, right?

Well I do a little — from the jazz world I went into Western swing, because it’s a logical step to go to Western swing which is a music originated by Bob Wills, a Texas fiddler in what the ‘30s I guess. And he combined Big Band and country music and it really worked. He used a fiddle section and horns and would take country songs and give them © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

the swing beat and it was very popular. So that was a very logical thing to do, to get into that music. And I was in a really fun big band that emulated that Bob Wills style. The band was called Ranch Dressing. And that was in Portland.
